option_relations.rationale: Developmental delay is a symptom, not a specific disease, and is not directly related to Hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia.
RASA1-related disorders (Capillary Malformation-Arteriovenous Malformation Syndrome) are distinct from Hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia, although both involve vascular malformations.
Vascular malformation of the nose is a finding, not a specific disease, and is not directly related to Hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia.
Concurrent Microcephaly-capillary malformation syndrome (MIC-CAP) and Mowat-Wilson syndrome (MWS) are distinct genetic syndromes and are not related to Hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia.
